name: workorai
description: WorkorAI talent marketplace skill and MCP server: candidates search and apply to jobs, employers run the job lifecycle and discover ranked candidates with white-box match explanations.

interface.shortDescription: Job search for candidates and ranked candidate discovery for employers
interface.longDescription: WorkorAI talent marketplace workflows through one skill: candidates search jobs, review explained matches, and apply directly from the agent; employers post and manage jobs, discover tiered candidates with white-box match explanations (fit score, interview-proven skills, gaps), send invitations, and review applicants. Credentials are role-aware and stored only with explicit consent.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find me a job, or post a job and find the top matching candidates
